header.name: Workcenter
header.description:
The Workcenter screen provides centralized management of manufacturing work centers within the industrial operations hierarchy. Work centers represent discrete production stations where manufacturing operations are performed, serving as the primary link between physical assets, production lines, and manufacturing cells.

**Key Features:**

- **Hierarchical Location Mapping**: Associates work centers with production lines and manufacturing cells for organizational clarity
- **ISA-101 State Management**: Tracks operational modes (Production, Idle, Disabled) and states (Running, Stopped, Held, Blocked, Starved, Faulted) following ISA-101 HMI standards
- **Work Order Integration**: Displays current work order assignments for active production tracking
- **Real-time Status Visibility**: Color-coded mode and state indicators provide at-a-glance operational status

**Filter Capabilities:**

- Workcenter code (partial match)
- Cell assignment
- Line assignment
- Operational mode
- Active/Inactive status
- Advanced GraphQL filtering

**CRUD Operations:**

- Create new work centers with cell/line assignments
- View detailed work center configuration
- Edit work center properties and assignments
- Duplicate existing work centers
- Deactivate work centers (soft delete)
- Delete work centers (with referential integrity protection)

**Data Model**: `Workcenter` **Module**: Machine Data Application **Group**: Machine Telemetry Site Application

props.label: Code
props.description:
**`code`** (`String!`)
Unique product identifier.

- Must be unique across all products.
- Format: `{FAMILY}-{TYPE}-{SEQ}` (e.g., BRK-PAD-001).
- Used in work orders and production logs.

props.label: Name
props.description:
**`name`** (`String!`)
Descriptive product name.

- Displayed in selection lists and reports.
- Should be human-readable and descriptive.

props.label: Status
props.description:
**`isActive`** (`Boolean`)
Product active status.

**Color Coding:**
• 🟢 **Active** (Green) - Available for production
• 🔴 **Inactive** (Red) - Not available

Inactive products cannot be selected for new work orders.

props.label: Created At
props.description:
**`createdAt`** (`DateTime!`)
Record creation timestamp.

- Auto-generated when product is created.
- Used for audit trails.

props.label: Created By
props.description:
**`createdByUser`** (`User!`)
User who created this product.

- Auto-populated from logged-in user.
- Displays full name.

props.description: A unique human readable identifier for the Schedule Group.
